---
title: "Long Vegetation Table"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  plot_number: "R3027"
  plot_numbers: ""
  site_unit: ""
  project_id: ""
  group_by: "layer"
  order_by: "presence"
  presence_min: 0
  cover_min: 0
  value_limit: 0
  avg_type: "by_n_plots"        # "by_n_plots" (Access: By n Plots) | "characteristic" (Access: Characteristic)
  show_common: "none"            # "none" | "english" | "code" | "attribute"
  show_field: ""                 # species attribute column when show_common="attribute": "RedBlueList" | "Wetland_Ind" | "WeedStatus"
  apply_lumping: false
  unit_groups: "site_unit"       # "site_unit" | "selected_fields" | "none"
  constancy_format: false
  display_value: "standard"
  colour_greater: 5
  gray_greater: 65
  apply_theme: true
  space_between_groups: false    # insert blank row between group sections
  create_summary: false          # append a summary section after the main table
  use_spp_codes_only: false      # collapse subspecies/variants to species code
  constant_spp_list: false       # fix species list across all unit groups
  screen_report: true            # skip heavy print-page formatting (faster)
  enforce_qc: false              # gate on data quality thresholds below
  site_quality_min: ""           # minimum site plot quality (PlotQualitySite lookup value)
  veg_quality_min: ""            # minimum veg plot quality
  soil_quality_min: ""           # minimum soil plot quality
  site_quality_include_null: true
  veg_quality_include_null: true
  soil_quality_include_null: true
  report_title: "Long Vegetation Report"
  project_root: ""
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
  parquet_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
has_kableExtra <- requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)
if (has_kableExtra) {
  kbl <- kableExtra::kbl
  kable_styling <- kableExtra::kable_styling
  cell_spec <- kableExtra::cell_spec
} else {
  kbl <- function(x, ...) knitr::kable(x, ...)
  kable_styling <- function(x, ...) x
  cell_spec <- function(x, ...) x
}
project_root <- params$project_root
db_root <- ""
db_path <- params$db_path
if (!is.null(db_path) && nzchar(trimws(db_path))) {
  db_candidate <- tryCatch(normalizePath(db_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), error = function(e) "")
  if (nzchar(db_candidate)) {
    db_root <- dirname(dirname(db_candidate))
  }
}
root_candidates <- c(
  if (!is.null(project_root)) project_root else "",
  db_root,
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""),
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "../..")
)
root_candidates <- unique(root_candidates[nzchar(root_candidates)])
root_dir <- NA_character_
for (candidate in root_candidates) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "R", "logic_lumping.R"))) {
    root_dir <- candidate
    break
  }
}
if (is.na(root_dir)) stop("Unable to locate project root for report helpers.")
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_lumping.R"))
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  dbExecute(con, "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lists")
  tbls <- c("vw_USysAllVeg", "Sample_SU", "Sample_Lump", "LayerCode", "Sample_Admin", "vw_USysEnv")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
  list_file <- file.path(parquet_dir, "lists_USysAllSpecs.parquet")
  if (file.exists(list_file)) {
    dbExecute(
      con,
      sprintf("CREATE TABLE lists.USysAllSpecs AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", gsub("'", "''", list_file))
    )
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
  lists_db <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "vpro_lists.duckdb")
  if (file.exists(lists_db)) {
    lists_db_norm <- normalizePath(lists_db, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
    dbExecute(con, sprintf("ATTACH '%s' AS lists", gsub("'", "''", lists_db_norm)))
  }
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
plot_number  <- if (is.null(params$plot_number))  "" else as.character(params$plot_number)
plot_numbers <- if (is.null(params$plot_numbers)) "" else as.character(params$plot_numbers)
plots <- parse_plot_numbers(plot_number, plot_numbers)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# unit_groups: 1/site_unit = use site-unit table; 2/selected_fields = manual
# selection; 3/none = no grouping filter beyond plot_numbers/plot_number.
# For "site_unit" the plots are already resolved by load_veg_report_data via
# the site_unit param; for "none" we pass plots as-is.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
unit_groups_val <- tolower(trimws(as.character(params$unit_groups)))

veg <- load_veg_report_data(
  con,
  plot_numbers    = plots,
  site_unit       = if (unit_groups_val == "site_unit") trimws(params$site_unit) else "",
  project_id      = trimws(params$project_id),
  apply_lumping   = isTRUE(params$apply_lumping)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# use_spp_codes_only: collapse subspecies / variety suffixes to the base 8-char
# species code (mirrors Access optCombineVariants / LVUseSppCodesOnly).
# E.g. "ABIELASL1" → "ABIELASL".
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (isTRUE(params$use_spp_codes_only) && nrow(veg) > 0) {
  veg$species <- substr(veg$species, 1, 8)
  # Re-aggregate cover within plot after collapsing codes
  veg <- veg |>
    dplyr::group_by(plotnumber, mylayer, species) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      cover_num   = sum(cover_num,   na.rm = TRUE),
      present_num = as.integer(sum(present_num, na.rm = TRUE) > 0),
      dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.character) & !dplyr::any_of(c("plotnumber","mylayer","species","cover")),
                    dplyr::first),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      present = present_num > 0,
      cover   = as.character(cover_num)
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data quality filtering (mirrors Access optEnforceQC / SitePlotQuality etc.)
# Quality columns are in vw_USysEnv (Sample_Env INNER JOIN Sample_Admin):
#   siteplotquality, vegplotquality, soilplotquality.
# Lookup values from USysTableOfLists 'DataQuality':
#   Poor (1) < Fair (2) < Good (3) < Excellent (4).
# If the view or columns are absent the filter is skipped silently.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (isTRUE(params$enforce_qc) && nrow(veg) > 0) {
  has_view <- tryCatch(DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "vw_USysEnv"), error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (has_view) {
    admin_df <- tryCatch(
      DBI::dbGetQuery(con,
        "SELECT plotnumber, siteplotquality, vegplotquality, soilplotquality
         FROM vw_USysEnv"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(admin_df) && nrow(admin_df) > 0) {
      admin_df$plotnumber <- as.character(admin_df$plotnumber)

      # Ordered quality levels matching USysTableOfLists 'DataQuality'
      quality_levels <- c("Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Excellent")

      # Helper: retain plots meeting the minimum quality threshold
      filter_quality <- function(plots_keep, env, col, min_val, include_null) {
        if (!col %in% names(env) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(min_val)))) return(plots_keep)
        min_str <- trimws(as.character(min_val))
        col_vals <- env[[col]]
        min_idx <- match(min_str, quality_levels)
        if (is.na(min_idx)) {
          # fallback: alphabetic comparison if value not in ordered list
          keep_rows <- env$plotnumber[
            (is.na(col_vals) & isTRUE(include_null)) |
            (!is.na(col_vals) & col_vals >= min_str)
          ]
        } else {
          val_idx <- match(col_vals, quality_levels)
          keep_rows <- env$plotnumber[
            (is.na(val_idx) & isTRUE(include_null)) |
            (!is.na(val_idx) & val_idx >= min_idx)
          ]
        }
        intersect(plots_keep, unique(keep_rows))
      }

      all_plots  <- unique(veg$plotnumber)
      plots_keep <- all_plots
      plots_keep <- filter_quality(plots_keep, admin_df, "siteplotquality",
                                   params$site_quality_min,
                                   isTRUE(params$site_quality_include_null))
      plots_keep <- filter_quality(plots_keep, admin_df, "vegplotquality",
                                   params$veg_quality_min,
                                   isTRUE(params$veg_quality_include_null))
      plots_keep <- filter_quality(plots_keep, admin_df, "soilplotquality",
                                   params$soil_quality_min,
                                   isTRUE(params$soil_quality_include_null))
      veg <- veg[veg$plotnumber %in% plots_keep, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# show_common resolution: map Access integer enum to logic_reports_veg string.
# Access: 0=none, 1=english, 2=8char code, 4=species attribute field.
# QMD param: "none" | "english" | "code" | "attribute".
# When show_common="attribute", show_field names the column (e.g. "Wetland_Ind").
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
show_common_val <- tolower(trimws(as.character(params$show_common)))
# Normalise numeric legacy values passed as strings
show_common_val <- switch(show_common_val,
  "0" = "none", "1" = "english", "2" = "code", "4" = "attribute",
  show_common_val
)

# avg_type resolution: map Access enum to logic function values.
# Access: "by_n_plots"/"10" → denominator = all plots (mean incl. 0-cover plots)
#         "characteristic"/"20" → denominator = only plots where species present
avg_type_val <- tolower(trimws(as.character(params$avg_type)))
avg_type_val <- switch(avg_type_val,
  "10" = "by_n_plots",
  "20" = "characteristic",
  "mean" = "by_n_plots",   # legacy default maps to By n Plots
  avg_type_val
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# summarize_veg_report uses avg_type: "sum_per_plot" ≡ by_n_plots,
#   and default (mean of present-only rows) ≡ characteristic.
# Map our enum to what the function currently accepts.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
avg_type_fn <- if (avg_type_val == "by_n_plots") "sum_per_plot" else "mean"

summary <- summarize_veg_report(
  veg,
  group_by      = if (isTRUE(params$constancy_format)) "lifeform" else params$group_by,
  order_by      = params$order_by,
  presence_min  = params$presence_min,
  cover_min     = params$cover_min,
  value_limit   = params$value_limit,
  avg_type      = avg_type_fn,
  show_common   = show_common_val,
  display_value = params$display_value
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# constant_spp_list: when TRUE the species list shown is fixed to the union of
# all species across all unit groups — every group shows every species (absent
# ones will have NA cover).  Achieved by cross-joining the full species list
# back to each group after summarization.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (isTRUE(params$constant_spp_list) && nrow(summary) > 0) {
  all_species <- unique(summary[, c("species_label", "common_label")])
  all_groups  <- unique(summary$group_label)
  full_grid   <- merge(
    data.frame(group_label = all_groups, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    all_species,
    all = TRUE
  )
  summary <- dplyr::left_join(
    full_grid, summary,
    by = c("group_label", "species_label", "common_label")
  )
  # Fill zeros for absent species
  summary$plots_present   <- tidyr::replace_na(summary$plots_present,   0)
  summary$presence_ratio  <- tidyr::replace_na(summary$presence_ratio,  0)
  summary$presence_pct    <- tidyr::replace_na(summary$presence_pct,    0)
  summary$mean_cover      <- tidyr::replace_na(summary$mean_cover,      0)
}

veg_labeled <- label_veg_records(veg, params$group_by, show_common_val)

# For show_common="attribute": attach the requested species attribute column.
if (show_common_val == "attribute" && nzchar(trimws(as.character(params$show_field)))) {
  attr_col <- trimws(as.character(params$show_field))
  if (attr_col %in% names(veg_labeled)) {
    veg_labeled$common_label <- as.character(veg_labeled[[attr_col]])
    summary$common_label     <- NA_character_  # will be re-joined below
  }
}

if (nrow(veg_labeled) > 0) {
  summary$common_key    <- ifelse(is.na(summary$common_label),    "", summary$common_label)
  veg_labeled$common_key <- ifelse(is.na(veg_labeled$common_label), "", veg_labeled$common_label)
  summary_keep <- summary[, c(
    "group_label", "species_label", "common_key",
    "presence_ratio", "presence_pct", "mean_cover",
    "display_value", "common_label"
  )]
  veg_labeled <- dplyr::inner_join(
    veg_labeled,
    summary_keep[, c("group_label", "species_label", "common_key")],
    by = c("group_label", "species_label", "common_key")
  )
}

veg_pivot <- data.frame()
if (nrow(veg_labeled) > 0) {
  veg_pivot <- veg_labeled %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group_label, species_label, common_key, plotnumber) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(cover = sum(cover_num, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

veg_wide <- data.frame()
if (nrow(veg_pivot) > 0) {
  veg_wide <- reshape(
    veg_pivot,
    idvar     = c("group_label", "species_label", "common_key"),
    timevar   = "plotnumber",
    direction = "wide"
  )
  plot_cols_raw <- grep("^cover\\.", names(veg_wide), value = TRUE)
  if (length(plot_cols_raw) > 0) {
    plot_cols <- sub("^cover\\.", "", plot_cols_raw)
    names(veg_wide)[match(plot_cols_raw, names(veg_wide))] <- plot_cols
  }
}

report_table <- data.frame()
if (nrow(summary) > 0) {
  summary$common_key <- ifelse(is.na(summary$common_label), "", summary$common_label)
  summary_keep <- summary[, c(
    "group_label", "species_label", "common_key",
    "presence_ratio", "presence_pct", "mean_cover",
    "display_value", "common_label"
  )]
  if (nrow(veg_wide) > 0) {
    report_table <- dplyr::left_join(
      summary_keep, veg_wide,
      by = c("group_label", "species_label", "common_key")
    )
  } else {
    report_table <- summary_keep
  }
}

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

# `r params$report_title`

`r if (isTRUE(params$apply_lumping)) "Lumping applied" else ""`

# Plot: `r params$plot_number`

```{r veg-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(report_table) > 0) {
  plot_cols <- setdiff(
    names(report_table),
    c("group_label", "species_label", "common_key", "presence_ratio",
      "mean_cover", "common_label")
  )
  plot_cols <- plot_cols[order(plot_cols)]

  constancy_format <- isTRUE(params$constancy_format)
  display_mode <- if (!is.null(params$display_value) && nzchar(params$display_value)) {
    tolower(params$display_value)
  } else {
    "standard"
  }

  # Build the display data frame
  view <- data.frame(
    Group   = report_table$group_label,
    Species = report_table$species_label,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (show_common_val != "none") {
    view$Common <- report_table$common_label
  }
  if (constancy_format) {
    view$Constancy <- round(report_table$presence_pct, 1)
  } else if (display_mode != "standard") {
    view$Display <- report_table$display_value
  } else {
    view$Presence  <- round(report_table$presence_ratio * 100, 1)
    view$MeanCover <- round(report_table$mean_cover, 1)
  }

  if (length(plot_cols) > 0) {
    plot_data <- report_table[, plot_cols, drop = FALSE]
    plot_data <- as.data.frame(lapply(plot_data, function(col) {
      if (is.numeric(col)) return(ifelse(is.na(col), "", round(col, 1)))
      num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(col))
      ifelse(is.na(num), ifelse(is.na(col), "", as.character(col)), round(num, 1))
    }), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    names(plot_data) <- plot_cols
    view <- cbind(view, plot_data)
  }

  # Colour theming
  apply_theme    <- isTRUE(params$apply_theme)
  colour_greater <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$colour_greater))
  gray_greater   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$gray_greater))

  if (apply_theme && nrow(view) > 0) {
    num_cols <- names(view)[vapply(view, is.numeric, logical(1))]
    if (length(num_cols) > 0) {
      style_numeric <- function(vec) {
        num    <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vec))
        labels <- ifelse(is.na(num), "", as.character(vec))
        vapply(seq_along(num), function(i) {
          value <- num[[i]]; label <- labels[[i]]
          if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(label)) return("")
          bg <- ""
          if (!is.na(gray_greater)   && value >= gray_greater)   bg <- "#e6e6e6"
          else if (!is.na(colour_greater) && value >= colour_greater) bg <- "#f9e27d"
          if (nzchar(bg)) cell_spec(label, background = bg) else label
        }, character(1))
      }
      for (col_name in num_cols) view[[col_name]] <- style_numeric(view[[col_name]])
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # space_between_groups: insert a blank spacer row at each group boundary.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (isTRUE(params$space_between_groups) && nrow(view) > 1) {
    grp_col <- view$Group
    breaks  <- which(c(FALSE, grp_col[-1] != grp_col[-length(grp_col)]))
    if (length(breaks) > 0) {
      blank_row <- as.data.frame(
        lapply(view, function(col) if (is.numeric(col)) NA_real_ else ""),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      # Insert blank rows from bottom to top so indices remain valid
      for (b in rev(breaks)) {
        view <- rbind(view[seq_len(b - 1), ], blank_row, view[b:nrow(view), ])
      }
    }
  }

  tbl <- kbl(view, align = "l", escape = !apply_theme) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = if (!isTRUE(params$screen_report))
        c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "bordered")
      else
        c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
      full_width = FALSE
    )
  tbl

} else {
  cat("No vegetation data found.")
}
```

```{r summary-section, echo=FALSE, results='asis', eval=isTRUE(params$create_summary)}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# create_summary: append a plot-count / species-count summary table after the
# main table (mirrors Access optCreateSummary / LVReportSummary).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (nrow(report_table) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n## Summary\n\n")
  n_plots   <- length(unique(veg$plotnumber))
  n_species <- length(unique(report_table$species_label))
  n_groups  <- length(unique(report_table$group_label))

  summ_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Plots included", "Species / taxa", "Groups"),
    Value  = c(n_plots, n_species, n_groups),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Per-group species counts
  group_counts <- report_table |>
    dplyr::group_by(Group = group_label) |>
    dplyr::summarise(`Species count` = dplyr::n_distinct(species_label), .groups = "drop")

  kbl(summ_df, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
  cat("\n\n")
  kbl(group_counts, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
}
```
